en.title: From a generated reference to a code-built film
en.does: Forms image-generation instructions and source-grounded code-built films, composing visual, narrative and technical competences through MKCV.
en.when: When a concept, documented result or authored scene should become a visual experience that can change meaningfully in time.
examples: Animate the world in the reference
A different relation asks for another geometry
en.description: Connect source knowledge, an observed visual reference, an editable scene and meaningful time.
en.subtitle: Connect source knowledge, an observed visual reference, an editable scene and meaningful time.

it.title: Da una reference generata a un film in codice
it.does: Forma istruzioni per immagini e film in codice fedeli alle sorgenti, componendo competenze visive, narrative e tecniche attraverso MKCV.
it.when: Quando un concetto, risultato documentato o scena autoriale deve diventare un’esperienza visiva che cambia significativamente nel tempo.
it.description: Collegare sapere sorgente, riferimento visivo osservato, scena modificabile e tempo significativo.
it.subtitle: Collegare sapere sorgente, riferimento visivo osservato, scena modificabile e tempo significativo.
